articles.title: Microsoft Pays Researcher $4,000 for Discovering Critical VS Code Security Bypass Flaw
articles.summary:
Microsoft awarded security researcher Sam Chen US$4,000 for reporting a flaw in Visual Studio Code that could let an attacker bypass Workspace Trust protections. The issue, tracked as CVE-2026-81376, affects VS Code versions earlier than 1.136.2 and has a critical CVSS score of 9.6. Microsoft has fixed the flaw; users should update to version 1.136.2 […]

The post Microsoft Pays Researcher $4,000 for Discovering Critical VS Code Security Bypass Flaw appeared first on GBHackers Security | #1 Globally Trusted Cyber Security News Platform.

articles.title: U.S. Agencies Warn AI Agents Could Exploit Security Flaws and Establish Hidden Backdoors
articles.summary:
U.S. agencies have warned that advanced AI agents could exploit security flaws, break out of their assigned limits, and leave hidden backdoors behind. New guidance from NIST, the National Security Agency, and CISA urges AI developers to prepare for incidents in which agents take harmful actions without being told to do so. Released on October […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Claude, DeepSeek and Grok in AI-Assisted Attacks on South Korean Banks
articles.summary:
Hackers linked to attacks on South Korean banks used Claude Code, DeepSeek, Grok, and Zhipu AI alongside ARTEX, an open-source AI penetration testing framework. The campaign shows how attackers can combine AI services with familiar hacking tools to search for weaknesses across different systems, while leaving evidence that helps investigators trace their work.
